issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification to revise the Resource.id comment so absence of an id is not limited to REST create; operation Parameters and other non-REST or transient use cases may also omit a logical id.
initial_application: Commit bfc3c04c9a00f50497c966d8db85b0861dd4d296 explicitly applied FHIR-27052 by changing source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml from the old create-only comment to wording scoped to FHIR RESTful interactions, with use outside REST depending on the use case.
additional_context: The referenced Zulip thread confirms operations were the motivating case, and FHIR-I minutes record the 14-0-0 persuasive vote. Current source/resource/resource-notes.xml also lists operation input/output resources, including Parameters, and non-REST exchanges as logical-id exceptions. Related FHIR-33978 and FHIR-33979 identity wording issues were already audited separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active Resource StructureDefinition and Resource Logical ID narrative already convey the approved REST-scoped and operation-aware rule.
